**Finding: ASSIGN — compliant (preferred).** 

Section 24 is favourable to us and needs no redline:
- **§ 24.1** — we may assign without Vendor consent to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition, or sale of substantially all assets (notice only).
- **§ 24.2** — Vendor may not assign, delegate material performance, or transfer by change of control without our prior written consent (not unreasonably withheld), and never to a direct Customer competitor.
- **§ 24.3** — mutual, not-unreasonably-withheld consent standard for other assignments.
- **§ 24.4** — our change of control gives Vendor no termination, suspension, repricing, acceleration, or service-reduction right; the walk-away trigger is expressly excluded.
- **§ 13.3** — we may also transfer licence rights to an Affiliate or successor.

Only minor wording sits short of preferred (the competitor bar reads "direct" competitor and is framed as subject to our consent). Noted in the rationale, not flagged.
